headline: On November 22, 1968: Japan Air Lines Flight 2 ditched in San Francisco Bay
captionCards: The aircraft was repaired and returned to service
instagramCaption:
Japan Air Lines Flight 2 ditched in San Francisco Bay.

A Douglas DC-8-62 named Shiga crashed near Coyote Point due to heavy fog. All 107 on board survived without injury. The plane was later recovered, repaired, and returned to service.

It remains a rare example of a successful ditching with no fatalities.
